title: Slim cans and small drinks only.
text:
Slim cans and small drinks only.. I got this thinking it would be useful to have a can insulator that also doubles as something to keep coffee hot / drinks cold. It DOES work for those purposes, but it wasn't until I tried it in person that I realized a normal sized can does not fit. A slim beer can? Sure. A regular Coke can? Nope.
That's ok, I'll just use it for coffee, right? Well, it's actually smaller than my other coffee insulated mugs/tumbler, we even have a Contigo tumbler that holds 16oz, whereas this seems to max out at 12. None of that is in the description otherwise I would have at least had more realistic expectations of what I was getting.
At the end of the day, it sort of ends up being a product that is pretty neat, but doesn't actually do anything useful to me. I don't buy skinny cans usually, and it isn't large enough to carry my drinks. If you want a smaller tumbler and buy skinny cans, I guess its ok.
